c-gating-builder-explains-itself.1.evidence: empty tab: 'No access rules - Only this space's visibility and join policy decide who gets in. Add a rule to let more people in by role, capability, trust level or membership.' Intro: 'A rule lets more people in to this space ... Who else gets in is set by the space's visibility and join policy.'

c-gating-builder-explains-itself.2.expected: each Rule type shows who it catches and an example; the Full preview matches what is stored
c-gating-builder-explains-itself.2.actual: Everyone, Logged In, Role, Capability and Trust Level each show a second sentence ('Matches anyone with an account on this site...' etc.) and a placeholder example (subscriber, edit_posts, 2). The Membership entry is not in the dropdown without a membership plugin. The Full preview says 'They are recorded as Moderator.' while the roster stores Member (checked with the enrolment hook, grants=full).

c-gating-builder-explains-itself.3.evidence: Everyone and Logged In hide the value box (display none); Role, Capability, Trust Level show it.

c-gating-builder-explains-itself.4.evidence: Trust Level with no value, 0 and 9 -> toast 'Choose a trust level from 1 to 5.' each time; no rule created.

c-gating-builder-explains-itself.5.evidence: Role 'ghost_role' -> toast 'Choose a role that exists on this site.'; no rule created.

c-gating-builder-explains-itself.6.evidence: empty Capability -> 'Enter a value for this rule.' (UI); REST empty capability and empty membership -> the same 400 jetonomy_invalid_rule_value.

c-gating-builder-explains-itself.7.evidence: POST /spaces/3078/access-rules with the bad values -> 400 jetonomy_invalid_rule_value with the same messages; GET lists no rule.

c-gating-builder-explains-itself.8.expected: test_editor builds a rule on Help Desk and sees the same explanations
c-gating-builder-explains-itself.8.actual: test_editor cannot open the builder at all: /wp-admin/admin.php?page=jetonomy-spaces&action=edit&space_id=3004&tab=access -> 403 'Sorry, you are not allowed to access this page.'; POST access-rules -> 403.

c-gating-builder-explains-itself.10.evidence: 390x844: dropdown, preview and sentence stack, Add Rule button 40px, scrollWidth 390.

c-gating-builder-explains-itself.11.expected: builder text readable in a dark scheme (4.5:1)
c-gating-builder-explains-itself.11.actual: wp-admin has no dark scheme (light #f0f0f0 even with prefers-color-scheme dark). The 'who the rule catches' sentence under the preview (.jt-rule-preview__note) is rgb(148,163,184) on white, about 2.6:1, and the tab labels measure 4.2:1; both are below 4.5:1.

c-gating-builder-explains-itself.12.evidence: admin user locale ar: the screen is RTL (direction rtl, lang ar), fields and preview text-align start; Jetonomy's own strings stay English because there is no Arabic Jetonomy translation. Locale restored.
